desc: Pullman Lubumbashi Grand Karavia welcomes you in the heart of a vast garden on the shores of Lake Kipopo. Ideal for business and leisure travelers, the hotel also offers 4 meeting rooms, an outdoor pool, tennis courts, 2 bars and 2 restaurants.
